Lesson 9: Modelling, Visualising and Analysing Network Data with R

##Getting Started

Install and launch the following R packages

pacman::p_load(igraph, tidygraph, ggraph, visNetwork, lubridate, clock, tidyverse, graphlayouts, concaveman, ggforce)

Data

Importing Data

GAStech_nodes <- read_csv("chap09/data/GAStech_email_node.csv")
GAStech_edges <- read_csv("chap09/data/GAStech_email_edge-v2.csv")

27.3.3 Importing network data from files

glimpse(GAStech_edges)
Rows: 9,063
Columns: 8

$ target      <dbl> 41, 40, 51, 52, 53, 45, 44, 46, 48, 49, 47, 54, 27, 28, 29…

27.3.5 Wrangling time

GAStech_edges <- GAStech_edges %>%
  mutate(SendDate = dmy(SentDate)) %>%
  mutate(Weekday = wday(SentDate, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE))

27.3.7 Wrangling attributes

GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>%
  filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>%
  group_by(source, target, Weekday) %>%
    summarise(Weight = n()) %>%
  filter(source!=target) %>%
  filter(Weight > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

27.4 Creating network objects using tidygraph

27.4.3 Using tbl_graph() to build tidygraph data model.

GAStech_graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = GAStech_nodes, edges = GAStech_edges_aggregated, directed = TRUE)

27.5 Plotting Static Network Graphs with ggraph package

27.5.1 Plotting a basic network graph

ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link() + geom_node_point()

27.5.2 Changing the default network graph theme

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes())

g + theme_graph()

27.5.3 Changing the coloring of the plot

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph) + geom_edge_link(aes(colour = 'grey50')) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = 'grey40'))

g + theme_graph(background = 'grey10', text_colour = 'white')

27.5.5 Fruchterman and Reingold layout

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes()) +
geom_node_point(aes())

g + theme_graph()

27.5.6 Modifying network nodes

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes()) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department,  size = 3))

g + theme_graph()

27.5.7 Modifying edges

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) +  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 3)

g + theme_graph()

27.6 Creating facet graphs

27.6.1 Working with facet_edges()

set_graph_style()

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2)

g + facet_edges(~Weekday)

27.6.2 Working with facet_edges()

set_graph_style()

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom')
  
g + facet_edges(~Weekday)

27.6.3 A framed facet graph

set_graph_style() 

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") +  geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2)
  
g + facet_edges(~Weekday) + th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

27.6.4 Working with facet_nodes()

set_graph_style()

g <- ggraph(GAStech_graph, layout = "nicely") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department), size = 2)
  
g + facet_nodes(~Department)+ th_foreground(foreground = "grey80", border = TRUE) + theme(legend.position = 'bottom')

27.7 Network Metrics Analysis

27.7.1 Computing centrality indices

g <- GAStech_graph %>%
  mutate(betweenness_centrality = centrality_betweenness()) %>%
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +  geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size=betweenness_centrality))
g + theme_graph()

27.7.2 Visualising network metrics

g <- GAStech_graph %>%
  ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = Department, size = centrality_betweenness()))
g + theme_graph()

27.7.3 Visualising Community

g <- GAStech_graph %>%
  mutate(community = as.factor(group_edge_betweenness(weights = Weight, directed = TRUE))) %>%
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +  geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(
aes(colour = community))  

g + theme_graph()
g <- GAStech_graph %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  mutate(community = as.factor(group_optimal(weights = Weight)),  betweenness_measure = centrality_betweenness()) %>%
  ggraph(layout = "fr") + geom_mark_hull(aes(x, y, group = community, fill = community), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.3, "cm"), radius = unit(0.3, "cm")) + geom_edge_link(aes(width=Weight), alpha=0.2) + scale_edge_width(range = c(0.1, 5)) + geom_node_point(aes(fill = Department, size = betweenness_measure), color = "black", shape = 21)
  
g + theme_graph()

27.8 Building Interactive Network Graph with visNetwork

27.8.1 Data preparation

GAStech_edges_aggregated <- GAStech_edges %>%
  left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("sourceLabel" = "label")) %>%
  rename(from = id) %>%
  left_join(GAStech_nodes, by = c("targetLabel" = "label")) %>%
  rename(to = id) %>%
  filter(MainSubject == "Work related") %>%
  group_by(from, to) %>%
    summarise(weight = n()) %>%
  filter(from!=to) %>%
  filter(weight > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

27.8.2 Plotting the first interactive network graph

visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated)

27.8.3 Working with layout

visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>%
  visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr")

27.8.4 Working with visual attributes - Nodes

GAStech_nodes <- GAStech_nodes %>%
  rename(group = Department) 
visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>%
  visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>%
  visLegend() %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 123)

27.8.5 Working with visual attributes - Edges

visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>%
  visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>%
  visEdges(arrows = "to", smooth = list(enabled = TRUE, type = "curvedCW")) %>%
  visLegend() %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 123)

27.8.6 Interactivity

visNetwork(GAStech_nodes, GAStech_edges_aggregated) %>%
  visIgraphLayout(layout = "layout_with_fr") %>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>%
  visLegend() %>%
  visLayout(randomSeed = 123)
